svg.aria-label: How openRocode works. The model receives annotated pictures and replies with clicks and programs. Inside the harness, providers feed the agent loop; every call passes hooks for argument checks, the safety gate and emergency stop; run_code calls the same pointing tools, which turn a pixel and depth into a 3D target and move the body. The recorder writes every event to runs/ for the dashboard, and an operator can say, pause or stop.
